notes: Background: it isn't a plain wall, and that's fine. The office with the city view, the suit and the Lyka pin look premium. A small corner window would look cluttered with all that detail, so you're full screen for the intro, the re-hook and the CTA. During the map, a cut-out of you (background removed) sits in the bottom corner.
The phone was handheld and the framing changes between clips. Cutting to the map between clips hides those jumps. I'll also crop each clip slightly so your size matches.

Hook: the opening as filmed ('Nakheel's new community…') is a soft hook. I recommend the cold open in beat 1, which teases 'jobs, airport, beaches, island' and pays it off at 0:42. Option B is to start as filmed, with ALL AROUND ONE COMMUNITY as on-screen text over beat 2.

I left out the 'capital appreciation' line and used 'imagine the potential', which is safer under advertising rules. The beach caption adds 'public' to match the official claim. Details are in translation.md.
Audio: the iPhone clips have some room or AC hum. I'll clean it with noise removal. The DJI clip is clean.

Trakheesi: this names an off-plan project and asks for comments. Please check with Lyka whether a permit number is needed on screen. The Lyka pin is visible, so the brokerage is effectively on screen.
Music: none chosen yet. I can use a soft generated bed, or you send a track you're allowed to use.
After you approve: I set up about 6 Google Earth camera moves in Chrome and you click Start on each one.
